scope: Pipeline save_settings validates supplied pins before any output write
behavior: Only supplied model_metadata invokes existing schema/identity validation.
Invalid schema/binding/hash/filename/version/kind/null metadata refuses before existing CSV/JSON outputs are opened.
Valid pins retain exact nested values/opaque versions in real CSV/JSON output.
No inference, enrichment, model hash read, acquisition, catalogue/provider/network access.
Legacy settings without model_metadata do not call pin validator and retain prior behavior.
limitations: Pure native fixture settings/output bytes; no models/GPU/network/fullCI or whole702 closure.
